newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sixt says 1996 turnover up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sixt says 1996 turnover up 25 pct.

text.p: German car rental firm Sixt AG said on Monday its 1996 group turnover rose 25 percent to 2.1 billion marks and that its group result would lie "not inconsiderably" above previously-given forecasts.
Sixt also said it was close to completing a deal to acquire a majority stake in the Recklinghausen-based Mohag GmbH, which Sixt described as the second-largest Ford dealership in the country.
Sixt also said it expected "considerable synergies" from the deal in respect of all its activities in car-leasing, hire, and new and used-car sales.
Definitive figures for the 1996 year would be published in March, Sixt said in the statement.
